announcements.headline: Cameroon Update
announcements.insight: Tower Resources provides a Cameroon update following earlier license updates in June and August. This continues the sequence of regulatory filings regarding its exploration rights.

announcements.headline: Change of Registered Address
announcements.insight: Administrative housekeeping. No financial or operational impact is indicated by this filing.

announcements.headline: License Update & Subscription to raise £325,000
announcements.insight: Tower Resources raises £325,000 via subscription following its June license update. This capital injection supports ongoing operations after earlier farmout and LTIP grants.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM & Total Voting Rights
Grant of Restricted Shares under LTIP
announcements.insight: Restricted shares were granted under the LTIP. This follows the June license update and subscription raise.

announcements.headline: License and Farmout Update & Subscription Raise
announcements.insight: The subscription raise follows the annual report. This capital action may dilute existing holdings.

announcements.headline: Posting of the Annual Report and Notice of Meeting
announcements.insight: Tower Resources has posted its Annual Report and Notice of Meeting. Shareholders should watch for the meeting results.
